rationale: Alter and Coleman argue that Howell’s objection to the necessitarian reply rests on misunderstandings of what the view says and why it is held.

sources.quote: But such a metaphysical contingency thesis does not entail that consciousness lacks physical efficacy.
In short, causation is arguably metaphysically contingent.
Contra Howell, necessitarianism is a viable option for Russellian monists.
